LESSON: READING 5.2.1 STUDY SKILLS- REFERENCE MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the importance of reference materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: READING 5.2.1 STUDY SKILLS- REFERENCE MATERIALS
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: READING 5.2.1 STUDY SKILLS- REFERENCE MATERIALS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects

What this means
In this part you learn to use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the importance of reference materials?
2. How can one use reference materials appropriately?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: use reference materials to obtain information on varied subjects.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
